card.name: The letter R starting drug and warning words
card.fires_on: The letter R (or r) that begins a new word piece after a break, such as in ritonavir, rilpivirine, rabeprazole, or capitalized warnings like RENAL and RISKS. It is seen in drug-interaction and boxed-warning text.

modes.label: R inside antiviral names
modes.description: R starts the second part of a joined antiviral name, such as rilpivirine or ritonavir.

modes.label: R in capitalized warnings
modes.description: R starts an all-caps warning word like RENAL or RISKS.

modes.label: R at start of other drug names
modes.description: R begins a drug name such as rabeprazole after a verb or a space.
modes.example: Use<< r>>abeprazole sodium delayed-release tablets with

card.plain: It lights up on the first letter R of drug names like ritonavir and of all-caps warning words like RENAL.
